boundary: Physical/schema ownership complete; semantic unit mappings live in the two ownership documents. retain_current is not a claim every field is essential. Declared empty types are included; this is not runtime migration acceptance.

candidate_action_attempts.writer_to_remove: Duplicated verified candidate_action_attempts.result_json provider body assignment
candidate_action_attempts.forward_rule: Only verified attempt whose raw result_json equals existing external receipt gets JSON null reference slot. Preserve all distinct results including {} and failed/uncertain results byte-exact.
candidate_action_attempts.inverse_rule: On CURRENT target, NULL verified attempt derives raw old result string from external receipt keyed by external_action_key; non-NULL remains attempt-local. Missing receipt refuses before mutation. New post-forward attempts included.

record_type_specific_rules.other_types: retain their existing result owner; shared generated column is not globally retired

fields.forward_rule: Require exact source declarations and canonical JSON bytes equal to exactly one decision_options item on physical candidate_id; repack only selection JSONB layout without branch slot. Keep IDs and other blobs exact.
fields.inverse_rule: Read current selections including post-forward inserts; resolve bound candidate_id + option_key; canonical serialize same option; repack frozen old layout and declarations. No stale row backup.

fields.writer_to_remove: Independent emails.class_folder assignment in classification/scan/compaction writers
fields.forward_rule: Require source class_folder IS message_folder with retained SQLite affinity/type; keep message_folder only and update classification projection.
fields.inverse_rule: Rebuild frozen emails declaration from CURRENT rows incl new writes; for classified rows reconstruct class_folder from message_folder; preserve all class-specific model/source/status/plan/version facts.
